$comment: Research data behind the routing table of 2026-11-03 (issue #60, decision 0024). It does not ship. etherscan is a frozen copy of the Etherscan chainlist, updated on 2026-11-05 when chains 11124 and 43113 left it (#165); routescan is the mainnet list of Routescan's supported-chains page plus chain 43113 from the Routescan research note of 2026-11-03; confirmed is true only where a live request confirmed the network; priorArt is the prior art's 67 rows re-checked; rows are the shipped table's rows with their names and the list each comes from, sourcify-chains for the 194 rows added on 2026-11-05 with Sourcify's chain names (#166, decision 0036); sources lists what the table was checked against. scripts/compare-routing-table.ts reads it.
